headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 22, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Chase Burns earning the win after pitching 5.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run. The Milwaukee Brewers also secured a win, defeating the Atlanta Braves 9-4 behind Robert Gasser's 6.0 innings of work and William Contreras' 4-hit performance. In other action, the Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 5-4, and the Kansas City Royals secured a narrow 2-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Blas Castaño, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies due to a right pectoral strain. The Miami Marlins have also made several roster moves, placing Josh Ekness on the 60-day injured list and Liam Hicks on the 10-day injured list. Other teams have also reported injuries, including the Athletics, Texas Rangers, Baltimore Orioles, Los Angeles Dodgers, and Boston Red Sox.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Washington Nationals trading Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Houston Astros traded Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for Cameron Sisneros, while the Arizona Diamondbacks traded Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Atlanta Braves traded Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Joey Bart, and the Seattle Mariners traded Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Yankees 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Chase Burns earning the win after pitching 5.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Braves 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 9-4 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Robert Gasser earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. William Contreras led the Brewers' offense with 4 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Tampa**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 3-4 decision to the Tampa Bay Rays, unable to overcome a late deficit. Jonny DeLuca led the Nationals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 4th-inning homer that scored Yandy Díaz.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 5-4 in a closely contested game. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees in their recent matchup. Amed Rosario and Riley Greene led the Tigers' offense, while Framber Valdez had a strong outing on the mound.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Rays in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Tampa Bay Rays, finalizing the score at 2-1. Chandler Simpson was a key contributor for the Royals in the game.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Castaño Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Blas Castaño has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Rotation with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have acquired right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff from the Washington Nationals.
